about.en: The Zcash ETF is a spot-ZEC exchange-traded product sponsored by Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, with Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC as custodian. Its shares are common units of fractional undivided beneficial interest whose value is intended to reflect the ZEC the trust holds, less expenses and liabilities, and they trade on NYSE Arca as ZCSH. It was formerly the OTCQX-quoted Grayscale Zcash Trust (ZEC), renamed and uplisted in August 2026, and is a fund share rather than an investment in ZEC itself.
